lus dkyil gyi skabs su/ rnam par snang mdzad kyi sa bon ni/ kha dog dkar po yi ge om̐/ /gzugs phung ngo bo nyid kyis ni/ /sngags shes pas ni spyi bor dgod/ /ces sogs rgyas par gsungs so/ /de bzhin du rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud gzhung mtha' dag las/ phung khams skye mched tha mal du 'dzin pa'i gzhi thams cad lha'i ngo bor bsgoms pas lhar gsal bar 'char ba'i tshul mtshungs par gsungs shing / de'i sgrub byed kun rdzob rang bzhin rnam dag gi lha yin par gsungs pa 'di las bzlog ste smra bar mi bya'o/ /gnyis pa rgyud kyi dgongs pa phyin ci ma log par bshad pa la gsum ste/ sbyang gzhi dang sbyong byed kyi don bshad pa/ de nyams len gyi rim pa la ji ltar sbyar ba'i tshul/ yid ches bskyed pa'i phyir 'khrul zad kyi lung khungs bstan pa'o/ /dang po ni/ sbyang gzhi dang sbyong byed kyi don/ rtsa rgyud le'u dang po las/ dngos po nyid kyis rnam grol zhing / /dngos po'i 'ching bas 'ching bar 'gyur/ /de yongs shes pas grol ba yin/ /dngos po med pa'ang yongs shes pas/ /dngos po bsgom gyur shes rab can/ /zhes dang / le'u dgu par/ phung po lnga dang dbang po drug /skye mched drug dang 'byung chen lnga/ /rang bzhin gyis ni rnam par dag /nyon mongs shes bya'i sgrib sbyang bya/ /kye bcom ldan 'das rnam par ma dag pa gang lags/ zhes pa nas/ dag pas dug med byas nas ni/ /bsten bya 'di dag bsten pa nyid/ /ces pa'i bar sngar drangs pa dang / gzugs phung rdo rje ma yin te/ /zhes sogs phung khams skye mched lha mo bco lnga'i ngo bor gsungs pa'i gzhung rnams dang / zhe sdang la sogs rnam sbyong pa/ /bskyed pa'i rim pa'i phyogs las ni/ /'dis ni phung po sbyang bar bya/ /zhes dang / phyi ma'i gnyis par/ de bzhin dngos po'i rnam rtog kyang / /rnam par nges pas sbyang bar bya/ /zhes dang / rdo rje gur las/

phal pa'i gnas skabs gzhom pa'i phyir/ /bsgom pa yang dag rab tu grags/ /rang bzhin gnas skabs bsgoms pa las/ /bsgom pa ma yin mi bsgom min/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi rtog pa de bzhin te/ 'on kyang mi gtsang ba'i tshad mnyam par sbyong ba'i phyir de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gzugs rab tu bsgom par bya'o/ /zhes dang / gal te 'gal ba yod pa ma yin yang / /de tshe rgyal ba'i dngos pos sbyang ba yod/ /kun rdzob gzugs su rnam par gnas nas ni/ /'khor lo'i gzugs kyi chos tsam rnam par brtags/ /zhes dang / gsang 'dus rtsa rgyud las/ mdor na phung po lnga rnams ni/ /zhes sngar drangs pa dang / sgrub thabs mdor byas las/ rnam rtog bag chags nyes pa yis/ /'gro ba gsum po rnam mang la/ /blo dang ldan pas legs bltas nas/ /rnal 'byor rgyud kyis sbyang bar bya/ /zhes dang / 'di dag skye mched rnam sbyong zhing / /lha yi mig sogs stsol ba'o/ /zhes pa rnams kyis bstan te/ zhib tu phye na rgyud dang / rgya gar ba'i gzhung tshad ldan rnams las 'di kho na bzhin du bshad do/ /'di dag gi don la sbyang gzhi/ sbyang bya/ sbyong byed/ sbyong tshul/ sbyangs 'bras ngos gzung ba dang lnga las/ dang po ni/ tha mal pa'i blo la phung po dang / khams dang / skye mched du snang ba dang / gzung ba dang 'dzin par snang ba'i kun rdzob kyi bden pas bsdus pa'i chos mtha' dag ste/ lha'i ngo bor rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pas lhar 'gyur ba'i gzhi yang yin/ tha mal gyi rnam rtog gis tha mal du gzung bas sbyang dgos pa'i gzhi yang yin pa'i phyir ro/ /'di ni sngar gyi lung rnams kyi dngos po nyid kyis zhes dang / phung po lnga dang dbang po drug /skye mched drug dang 'byung chen lnga/ /zhes dang / bsten bya 'di dag ces dang / gzugs phung rdo rje ma yin te/ /zhes sogs kyis phung khams skye mched ston pa'i tshig rnams dang / zhe sdang la sogs zhes dang /

phung po zhes dang / gur las/ chos tsam zhes dang / gsang 'dus las/ phung po lnga rnams ni zhes sogs kyis bstan to/ /'di dag kyang kun rdzob tu yin gyi/ dam pa'i don du sbyang gzhi med de/ mi thub zla bas yan lag drug par/ gzugs phung rdo rje ma yin te/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang drug gsungs nas/ mjug tu/ dam pa'i don du phung po med/ /ces gsungs pas so/ /gnyis pa ni snang ba 'di dag la bden par 'dzin pa'am/ bden 'dzin gyi sgro 'dogs chod nas brtags pa tsam du 'dzin pa gang yin kyang rung ste/ lha'i ngo bor ma shes par 'di ni gzugs so/ /'di ni tshor ba'o/ /zhes sogs snang ba rang dgar 'dzin pa'i rtog pa thams cad de/ 'di ni 'khor bar 'ching ba'i rgyu yin pas 'ching ba zhes dang / yul gyi spu ris phye nas mngon par zhen pas mtshan rtog ces dang / thun mong gi skabs su bden 'dzin la nyon sgrib dang / 'di la shes sgrib tu 'jog pas shes sgrib ces dang / gang zhig mya ngan 'das pa 'chi bar byed pas dug ces dang / dngos po tsam la rnam par rtog pas dngos po'i rnam rtog ces dang / tha mal du 'dzin pas phal pa'i gnas skabs zhes dang / mi gtsang ba'i tshad ces pa'i tha snyad du mas bstan pa'o/ /'di dag kyang sngar gi lung rnams kyi dngos po'i 'ching ba zhes sogs kyis bstan te go sla'o/ /'o na rnam rtog de nyid sbyang gzhi ma yin na/ phung khams skye mched kyi chos su 'dod pa dang 'gal zhing / yin na sbyang byar bshad pa dang 'gal lo snyam na/ gzhi gzhan gyi steng du rnam rtog de nyid sbyang bya yin kyang / de nyid la tha mal du rnam par rtog pa'i tshe/ yul gyi rnam rtog sbyang gzhi dang / yul can gyi rnam rtog sbyang byar 'dod pas mi 'gal lo/ /gsum pa ni rnam thar sgo gsum dang / byang phyogs so bdun dang / ye shes lnga la sogs pa chos sku'i yon tan rnams dang / rigs lnga yum bzhi sogs gzugs sku gdan gsum tshang ba'i lha tshogs rnams ni sbyong byed yin te/

sngar gyi lung rnams kyi dngos po bsgom 'gyur zhes pa'i dngos po dang / dag pas zhes dang / rdo rje ma yin te zhes sogs lha ston pa'i tshig rnams dang / gur las/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gzugs zhes dang / rgyal ba'i dngos pos zhes dang / gsang 'dus las/ sangs rgyas lngar ni rab tu bsgrags/ /zhes sogs kyis bstan no/ /bzhi pa ni rnal 'byor pas sbyang gzhi phung khams skye mched kyi chos thams cad tha mal pa ma yin par rnam thar sgo gsum mam/ byang phyogs so bdun nam/ ye shes lnga'am/ rigs lnga yum bzhi la sogs pa'i ngo bor bsgom pa ste/ 'di la mnyam gzhag gi rnal 'byor gyis sbyang tshul dang / rjes spyod kyi rnal 'byor gyis sbyang tshul gnyis las/ dang po ni/ ye shes tshogs bsag gis snang ba'i dngos po thams cad stong nyid du sbyangs pa'i stong nyid dang / sems gsal ba dang tha mi dad pa'i gsal stong zung 'jug la mnyam par gzhag nas/ de las langs pa'i tshe kun rdzob tha mal pa'i snang ba 'char du mi 'jug par/ rten dang brten par bcas pa'i 'khor lo bsgoms nas de kun rdzob kyi snang ba dang dbyer med du bsgoms pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ mnyam gzhag las langs nas rjes spyod kyi tshe thog ma med pa'i bag chags kyi dbang gis snang ba'i dngos po mthong thos thams cad tha mal du 'dzin pa rang shugs kyis skye la/ de'i tshe dran pa'i rtsis zin par byas nas tha mal gyi rnam rtog bkag ste/ 'di ni lha'o snyam du bsgoms pas sngar gi mnyam gzhag gi rtogs pa bogs dbyung ba'o/ /'di'i gnad kyang mnyam rjes gnyis po sbyang gzhi gcig yin pa dang / sbyong tshul tha mal gyi rnam rtog spong bar gcig pa'i phyir ro/ /'di dag kyang sngar gyi lung rnams kyi de yongs shes pas zhes dang / dngos po med pa'ang yongs shes pas/ /dngos por bsgom 'gyur zhes dang / dug med byas nas ni/ bsten pa nyid ces pa'i tshig sbrel ba dang /

rnam par nges pas sbyang bar bya/ /zhes dang / gur las/ bsgom pa yang dag rab tu grags/ /zhes dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gzugs bsgom par bya'o zhes dang / 'khor lo'i gzugs kyis chos tsam rnam par brtags zhes pa'i tshig sbrel ba rnams kyis bstan no/ /lnga pa ni phung khams skye mched kyi chos 'di dag lha'i ngo bor bsgoms pas glo bur gyi dri ma dag nas chos sku'am/ gzugs sku'i ngo bor gyur pa ste/ rtag tu 'di dag rnam dag pas/ /de nyid rnal 'byor pas 'grub 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /'di dag kyang gzhi gcig gi steng du gnad mdor bsdus na/ gzugs phung ni sbyang gzhi/ rnam par snang mdzad dam/ rdo rje ma ni sbyong byed/ gzugs phung lhar ma shes par/ gzugs phung tsam du 'dzin pa ni sbyang bya/ gzugs phung rnam snang ngam/ rdo rje ma'i ngo bor rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag par shes nas/ mnyam bzhag dang / rjes thob kyis lhar bsgom pa ni sbyong tshul de ltar bsgoms pas gzugs phung rnam snang ngam/ rdo rje ma'i ngo bor gnas gyur pa ni sbyangs 'bras te/ thams cad la 'di bzhin du sbyar bar bya'o/ /ye shes lngar bsgom tshul la rnam pa gzugs kyi rnam par bsgom dgos pas/ zla ba la sogs pa mngon byang lnga po re re'i steng du snga ma bzhin sbyar bar bya'o/ /'khor 'das dbyer med kyi 'grel par sbyang gzhi ni 'khor ba'i chos/ sbyong byed ni 'bras bu ste mya ngan las 'das pa'i chos/ de sbyar ba ni/ 'khor 'das dbyer med du bsgom pa ste bskyed rdzogs kyi rnal 'byor nyid la bshad pa yang 'di dang gnad gcig par shes par bya'o/ /gnyis pa la bdun te/ sngon 'gros las nyon sbyong tshul/ dngos gzhi rten gyis snod sbyong tshul/ bskyed chog gis skye gnas bzhi sbyong tshul/ lha bsdu bas 'chi srid sbyong tshul/ lha'i rnam pas dug gsum sbyong tshul/ kha dog dang dbyibs kyis dug lnga sbyong tshul/

phyag zhabs kyi rnam 'gyur gyis mtha' gnyis sbyong tshul lo/ /dang po ni ljon shing las sngon 'gro tshogs gnyis bsag pas tshe snga ma'i las dang nyon mongs pa sbyang bar gsungs la/ 'bras bu'i rnam pa lam byed bskal pa grangs med gsum du tshogs bsag pa'i dod yin par gsungs so/ /bod phal cher ye shes tshogs bsag 'chi srid sbyong byed la sbyor bar 'dod kyang / rje btsun gong ma'i gsung rab las/ de'i gsal kha mi snang zhing sbyang gzhi'i gtso bo skye 'chi bar do gsum la byed pa'i tshe na yang las 'phen gcig gis 'phangs pa'i chos gsum dgos shing / tshe snga ma'i 'chi srid ni tshe 'di'i bar do skye srid gnyis dang / las 'phen gcig gis 'phangs pa ma yin pas sbyang gzhi la brtags na yang mi 'thad do/ /sbyong byed la brtags na yang mi 'thad de sbyang gzhi'i gtso bo chos gsum po de sbyong byed kyi gtso bo mngon rtogs kyi dngos gzhis sbyang dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /ye shes zhabs lugs sogs rgya gar ba kha cig ye shes tshogs bsag gi de ma thag tu bar srid mtshon byed kyi yi ge lnga la sogs pa langs par gsungs pa yang sbyang gzhi chos gsum gyi thog ma ngos 'dzin pa yin gyi chos gsum gyi nang tshan gyi 'chi srid sbyong byed sngon du song nas bar srid langs pa ma yin te/ chos gsum gyi go rim dang 'gal ba'i phyir ro/ /ye shes tshogs bsag 'chi srid sbyong byed la sbyar ba'i 'khrul gzhi 'dis byas nas bla ma phyi ma dag kye rdor gyi skabs su ye shes tshogs bsag gi de ma thag bar srid mtshon byed kyi yig 'bru lnga langs dgos par 'dod pa ni/ rje bla mas rgyas par bkag pa sngar brjod zin to/ /sbyang gzhi ni sngar bshad pa ltar yin la/ dgos pa gsum po ni rje sa chen gyis gsungs pa gong du brjod zin to/ /gnyis pa ni srung ba'i 'khor lo ljon shing las gsal kha mi snang / rga ston spring yig tu srod la bdud btul ba mtshon zhes gsungs pa ni/

'bras bu'i rnam pa lam byed yin cing sbyang gzhi ma yin no/ /'dus pa'i bla ma kha cig phyi'i lcags ri sbyong bar gsungs kyang / gzhal yas khang gis snod kyi 'jig rten sbyong tshul phyi'i rgya mtsho yan chad la sbyar ba kho na yin na/ 'di 'thad du chug kyang de'i nges pa mi snang ngo / /'o na ci ltar zhe na bla chen 'phags pas/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi mi mthun phyogs mtha' dag sbyong bar gsungs pa 'di nyid legs par mthong ste/ sbyang gzhi'i skabs su 'jig rten pa rnams go cha gyon pa dang / sman gtong ba la sogs pas lus kyi bar chad bzlog pa dang / ngag mnan zlog pa sogs ngag gi bar chad bzlog pa dang / smyo 'bogs sems 'khrul sogs sems kyi bar chad bzlog pa'i thabs la rtsol ba byed pa yod pas de sbyong byed de dang rnam pa 'dra ba dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /de nas gzhi'i yan lag chos 'byung gru gsum gyis ni skye gnas bzhi char gi snod sbyong ste/ mngal skyes la ma'i bha ga dang / sgong skyes la sgo nga dang / rdzus skyes la me tog padma la sogs pa dang / drod gsher skyes la rang gang du skyes pa'i sa gzhi dang / nam mkha' rnams kyang stod rgyas shing smad zhum pa'i rnam pa can du yod pas rnam pa mthun pa'i phyir ro/ /'bras bu'i rnam pa lam byed ni/ rje btsun rtse mos/ sku gsung thugs snying po'i phyir gru gsum zur bzhi pa'o/ /zhes gsungs shing / rje btsun gyis sangs rgyas pa'i rnam thar sgo gsum mtshon la/ sa dang po la sogs pa'i yon tan gong nas gong du rgyas pa mtshon pas stod 'phel kha che ba/ thabs shes zung du 'jug pas phyi dkar la nang dmar bar gsungs so/ /de nas rgyu'i yan lag las nas bsgom pa'i 'byung bzhi lugs bzlog dang / rlung nas bsgom pa'i 'byung bzhi lugs 'byung gnyis las/ dang pos ni mngal gyi sngon 'gro sbyong ste/ rtsa rgyud dang po'i bcu par/ reg pa sra ba'i bag chags kyis/

/sa ni de las skye bar 'gyur/ /byang sems gsher ba'i rnam pa yis/ /chu yi khams ni 'byung bar 'gyur/ /bskyod pa las ni drod skye ste/ /'gro ba rlung du rab tu grags/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar gyi go rim sbyong bas so/ /yang lus kyi dkyil 'khor la sbyar na/ lte ba sa/ snying ga chu/ mgrin pa me/ spyi bor rlung sbyong ba'i rim pa'i dbang du byas pa'o/ /gnyis pas ni mngal gyi dngos gzhi sbyong ste/ phyag chen thig le las/ rnam shes las ni skyes pa rlung / /de las me ni skye bar 'gyur/ /de las chu ni 'byung bar 'gyur/ /de las dbang chen 'byung bar 'gyur/ /de las phung po 'byung bar 'gyur/ /de las ye shes skye bar 'gyur/ /brgya rtsa brgyad kyi sbyor bas so/ /zhes gsungs pa'i rim pas sbyong ba'o/ /des na skabs 'dir bar do bsre ba yang mngal gyi dngos gzhi'i gnas skabs su bar do 'jug pas de sbyong zhing / sbyong byed la yang gzugs kyi rnam pa gzhal yas khang du bsgom pa yang ngo bo rnam par snang mdzad lam du byed pa'i gnad kyis so/ /'byung bzhi'i steng du 'khor lo bsgom pas ni/ de las phung po 'byung bar 'gyur/ /de las ye shes skye bar 'gyur/ /brgya rtsa brgyad kyi sbyor bas so/ /zhes pa sbyong bar mngon no/ /yang 'di nyid lus la sbyar na/ rkang mthil rlung / sum mdo me/ lto ba chu/ snying ga sa yin pa'i rim pa sbyong zhing / phyi snod kyi 'jig rten la sbyar na/ rlung nas rim pa bzhin chags pa sbyong ngo / /'di la dus 'khor ba dag me'i dkyil 'khor dngos su yod par bzhed kyang rgyud sde gzhan rnams la mngon pa dang sgo bstun nas me'i dkyil 'khor dngos su med kyang dkyil 'khor gzhan gsum la me'i rdul phra rab yod pa sbyang gzhi yin pa grub chen klu'i byang chub kyi gsung pa de nyid blang bar bya'o/ /'di gnyis char la yang 'bras bu'i rnam pa lam byed ni sa sogs 'byung ba bzhis lha mo bzhi dang /

tshad med bzhi mtshon/ 'khor los ni rnam par snang mdzad mtshon pa'o/ /de nas rkyen gyi yan lag la lugs 'byung la bar do bsre ba'i sbyong tshul ni bshad zin cing / lugs bzlog la rang gi sems snang bsre bas ni/ gzhi'i skabs su snod kyi snang ba thams cad rang sems yin pa sbyong zhing lam gyi skabs su gzhal yas khang du snang ba rang sems yin pa mtshon no/ /de nas gnas thabs kyi yan lag gzhal yas khang gis ni phyi snod kyi 'jig rten sbyong ste/ spyi tsam gyi dbang du byas na/ ma dag pa'i snod kyi 'jig rten mtha' dag dang / de las bsdu na mi mjed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams dang / gling bzhi ri rab dang bcas pa dang / 'dzam bu gling la sogs pa rang gang du gnas pa'i gling dang / rang gang du gnas pa'i gnas khang ste/ mdor na ma dag pa'i blo la rten dang brten pa gnyis su snang ba'i rten mtha' dag sbyong ba'o/ /'bras bu'i rnam pa lam byed ni sangs rgyas pa'i byang phyogs so bdun mtshon pa ste/ 'di la bla ma gong mas bde dgyes kyi skabs su rgyud rdo rje rtse mo nas gsung pa gtso bor mdzad la 'dus pa 'phags lugs dang / ye shes zhabs lugs sogs rnams las/ rgyud sde gzhan las gsungs pa'i sbyor tshul mi 'dra ba du ma snang yang don gyi gnad gcig par shes par bya'o/ /de ni chos sku'i dbang du byas la/ gzugs sku'i dbang du byas na 'og min gyi gzhal yas khang pa'am/ rdo rje'i gdan du byin gyis brlab pa'o/ /gsum pa la gnyis te/ mngon rtogs yongs su rdzogs pas skye gnas bzhi sbyong ba dang / mngon byang lnga po kho nas skye gnas bzhi sbyong ba'o/ /dang po ni/ mngon byang lnga'i nyi ma ni drod dang / zla ba ni gsher yin pas drod gsher skyes sbyong / yang nyi ma ni ma'i khrag dang / zla ba ni pha'i khu ba yin pas mngal skyes sbyong / gnyis ka la'ang mngon byang gsum pas bar do sbyong ngo / /'khor gyi lha mo mngal nas 'byin pas mngal skyes sbyong /

'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa thig le'i gong bu las bzhengs pa dang / rga ston spring yig ltar na/ rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa'ang ro gcig tu 'dres pa'i thig les sgong skyes sbyong / de las yid kyi lus kyi lhar gyur pas ni rdzus skyes sbyong / skye mched kyi lha skad cig ma'am/ sa bon tsam las bskyed pas rdzus skyes sbyong ngo / /ljon shing las/ 'di tsam zhig las gzhan sbyar ba mi snang yang / 'bras bu'i rnam pa lam byed kyi skabs dang rung mthun sbyar na/ snod bcud sbyang bas ni 'phral gyi lus ngag gi bya bas gzhan la phan pa sgrub pa sbyong / ye shes kyi 'khor lo dgug gzhug gis ni lus sems yongs su rdzogs pa sbyong / dbang bskur bas ni rgyal po'i rigs yin na rgyal sar dbang bskur ba'am/ phal pa la'ang rang rang gi gzhi 'dzin pa sbyong / de nas sngags kyi bzlas pa la sogs pas ni 'phral gyi 'jig rten gyi bya ba sna tshogs grub pa sbyong ngo / /gnyis pa ni skye gnas dang po gnyis kyi sbyong tshul ni bshad zin la/ sgong skyes la nyi ma ni ma dang / zla ba ni pha mtshon la/ rdzus skyes la nyi ma ni stong pa dang / zla ba ni gsal ba ste/ thams cad la yang mngon byang gsum pa ni bar do'i sbyong byed do/ /bzhi pa ni spyir bskyed rim gyis skye ba dang / rdzogs rim gyis 'chi ba sbyong ba yin na bskyed rdzogs re res kyang skye 'chi bar do dang / sbyang gzhi mtha' dag sbyong ba yin pas 'dir bskyed rim gyis 'chi ba sbyong ba'i tshul ni ljon shing las/ dkyil 'khor bsdu bas ni snod bcud 'jig pa sbyong ngo zhes gsungs pa'i snod 'jig pa ni me chu rlung gsum gyis 'jig pa yin la/ de ni khams gsum snod bcud srung ba'i 'khor lo la bsdu ba nas gzhal yas khang lha mo brgyad la bsdu ba'i bar gyis sbyong / bcud 'jig pa ni sems can 'chi ba yin la/ de ni lha mo brgyad zhal brgyad la bsdu ba nas/

nā da'ang mi dmigs te stong nyid du 'gyur bas sbyong ngo / /'di la yan lag drug par gtso bo yab yum ni nyal ba'i rnal 'byor gyi bar du bsdu ba med do/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar na nyal ba'i rnal 'byor de nyid kyis sbyong ngo / /des na mngon rtogs kyi dngos gzhis las 'phen gcig gis 'phangs pa'i skye 'chi bar do gsum sbyong ba'i tshe thog mar pha ma'i khu khrag dang / bar do ro gcig tu 'dres pa de nas mngal gyi gnas skabs lnga rdzogs nas phyir btsas pa/ de nas de nyid 'chi ba gsum rim can du 'byung bas sbyong byed la yang gsum po rim can du dgos pa ni/ rje btsun gong ma 'khrul pa'i dri ma zad pa dag gi gsung rab las 'byung gi gzhan la mi snang ngo / /mngon byang lnga nas 'di'i bar gyi 'bras bu'i rnam pa lam byed ni/ rje btsun gyis mngon par byang chub pa lnga'i rim pas lha'i rnam pa grub pa ni/ 'og min nam rdo rje gdan gyi steng du tho rangs sangs rgyas pa dang 'dra/ khams gsum chos kyi rgyal por mngon par dbang bskur nas 'od zer gyi 'phro 'dus sems can gyi don byed pa dang bzlas pa la sogs pa chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang mthun/ bskyed pa'i rim pa bsdus te/ stong pa nyid du bsgoms pas yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa dang mthun te/ de ltar mdzad pa bcu gnyis dang mthun pas sangs rgyas kyi phrin las mdzad nas slar yang mdzad pa rgyun mi 'chad pa dang 'dra bar stong pa nyid kyi ngang las lha'i skur langs nas spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor gyi tshul gyis sems can gyi don byed pa yin no zhes gsungs so/ /lnga pa lha'i rnam pas dug gsum sbyong tshul ni shin tu zab pa'i bskyed pa'i rim pa khro chags kyi rnam pa ste khro bo'i skur bzhugs pas zhe sdang sbyong / btsun mo'i 'khor gi dbus na bzhugs pas 'dod chags sbyong / mtshan dang dpe byad kyis brgyan pa'i gzugs kyi skur bsgoms pas gti mug zhi bar byed pa yin te/

rdo rje gur las/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug dang / /nga rgyal ser sna'i skye bo rnams/ /bsdu phyir rang gi 'khor lo la/ /rdo rje gzugs ni du ma 'dzin/ /zhes pa dang / /zhe sdang 'dul ba'i dbang du byas nas/ shin tu gdug pa drag po la/ /zhi ba nye bar mi sbyar te/ /'di mkhyen rdo rje can gyis ni/ /bdag nyid kye yi rdo rjer 'gyur/ /zhes pa dang / gti mug 'dul ba'i dbang du byas nas/ shin tu stong par zhen rnams kyis/ /yod min brtul zhugs 'dzin rnams kyi/ /don du sangs rgyas gti mug sbyong / /rdo rje rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'gyur/ /zhes pa dang / 'dod chags 'dul ba'i dbang du byas te/ /byang chub chags bral las skyes spangs/ /sems can gang zhig bde byed pa/ /chags pas byang chub rab sbyin phyir/ /padma gar gi dbang phyug 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /de ltar khro chags kyi skus rtsa ba'i nyon mongs pa gsum zhi bar byed pa yin pas na nyon mongs pa gzhan rnams shugs las zhi bar byed pa yin no/ /khro chags kyi rnam pa'i sku med pa rnams ni bskyed pa'i rim pa mi zab pa yin no/ /yang sgeg pa/ dpa' ba/ mi sdug pa ste sku'i nyams gsum gyis rim pa ltar 'dod chags dang / zhe sdang dang / gti mug sbyong / dgod cing drag shul 'jigs su rung ba ste/ gsung gi nyams gsum gyis kyang rim pa ltar de gsum sbyong ngo / /snying rje ngam dang zhi ba ste thugs kyi nyams gsum gyis kyang rim pa ltar de gsum sbyong ngo / /drug pa kha dog dang dbyibs kyis dug lnga sbyong tshul la gnyis te/ kha dog gis dug lnga sbyong tshul dang / phyag mtshan gyis dug lnga sbyong tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ gti mug can ni gang du'ang bsgyur du 'dod cing / me long lta bu'i ye shes kyang ye shes gzhan gsum gyi gzhi yin pa'i phyir/ kha dog dkar pos mtshon yang zhe sdang skyes pa'i tshe nag tom gyis 'gro la/ chos dbyings ye shes kyang 'gyur ba med pa'i phyir kha dog nag pos mtshon/

yang 'dod chags skyes pa'i tshe kha dog dmar la/ so sor rtog pa'i ye shes sems can gyi don la chags pas kha dog dmar pos mtshon/ yang longs spyod 'dzin pa ni ser sna yin la/ longs spyod yod pa rnams la nga rgyal skye zhing longs spyod kyi gtso bo rin po che dang / gser la sogs pa rnams ni 'od gsal ba dang / mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes kyang 'od gsal bas ser pos mtshon/ yang nyon mongs pa phrag dog ni nyon mongs pa kun ldan las skye ba yin la/ bya ba grub pa'i ye shes kyang ye shes thams cad kyi phrin las yin pas kha dog ljang gus mtshon te/ kha dog lnga po gang yod sar 'di lta bu'i sbyang gzhi dang sbyong byed ngo sprad cing bsgoms pas/ nyon mongs pa lnga ye shes lngar byin gyis brlabs pa yin no/ /gnyis pa ni/ phyag mtshan 'khor los nyon mongs pa gti mug dang / me long lta bu'i ye shes mtshon/ rdo rje zhe sdang dang / chos dbyings ye shes mtshon/ rin po ches nga rgyal dang / ser sna dang / mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes mtshon/ padmas 'dod chags dang / so sor rtog pa'i ye shes mtshon/ ral gri'am sna tshogs rdo rjes phrag dog dang / bya ba grub pa'i ye shes mtshon la/ de bzhin du phyag mtshan gzhan rnams la yang rung mthun brtsi bar bya'o/ /srog chags kyi phyag mtshan rnams ni mtshon byed bzang ba yin te/ re re la yang phung po lnga dang / nyon mongs pa lnga dang / ye shes lnga la sogs pa'i sbyang gzhi sbyong byed thams cad tshang ba'i phyir ro/ /de ltar phyag mtshan thams cad la sbyang gzhi sbyong byed ngo sprad cing bsgoms pas nyon mongs pa lnga/ ye shes lngar byin gyis brlabs pa yin no/ /bdun pa phyag zhabs kyi rnam 'gyur gyis mtha' gnyis sbyong tshul ni/ phyag dang zhabs g.yas brkyang bas ni snying rje chen pos sems can gyi don byed pa mtshon la/ bskum pas ni bdag thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa mtshon/ g.yon brkyangs pas ni chos nyid stong pa nyid kun la khyab pa mtshon/

des 'khor ba'i mtha' mnan no/ /bskum pas ni bdag dang de bzhin nyid du ldan pa mtshon/ des mya ngan las 'das pa'i mtha' mnan no/ /phyag gnyis thugs kar bsnol ba dang / zhabs rdo rje skyil krung du bzhugs pas ni zung du 'jug pa mtshon te/ des mtha' gnyis char sbyong ngo / /de ltar na rje btsun gyis ljon shing las sbyang gzhi dang sbyong byed thams cad ngo sprad pa/ lam thams cad gcig tu bsre ba 'di ni/ rje btsun rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po'i bzhed pa yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don yin la/ 'di tshul bzhin shes nas bsgom na/ rga ston spring yig las/ spyir sbyang gzhi dang / sbyong byed legs par ngo 'phrod cing bsgoms na/ bsgom pa la brtson yang rung ma brtson yang rung 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las bdag sgrol zhing gzhan sgrol ba'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar gyi 'bras bu 'byung bar shes nas bka' srol 'di lta bu'i rjes su 'brang bar bya ba yin gyi/ chos dbyings bden grub kho na sbyang gzhi yin gyi/ kun rdzob phung khams skye mched thams cad sbyang gzhi ma yin no zhes shin tu 'chal zhing / rnam par 'chal ba'i shes rab kyis log par rtog pa'i rjes su 'brang bar mi bya'o/ /spyir gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i gnad phyin ci ma log par rtogs pa la/ rje sa chen gyis/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i bka' ni rgya mtsho bzhin/ /zab cing gting dpag dka' la thug pa med/ /rdo rje theg pa dgongs pa du ma yis/ /gsung shing rdo rje'i tshig gis rgyas btab pas/ /lung bstan gyur pa klu sgrub la sogs sam/ /mkha' 'gros byin brlabs birwa pa la sogs/ /grub thob rnams kyi man ngag la brten nas/ /rjes 'jug skye bos bka' rnams rtogs par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ bka' srol rnam par dag pa'i rjes su 'brang dgos pa 'di'ang nges par bya'o/ /gsum pa yid ches bskyed pa'i phyir 'khrul zad kyi lung khungs bstan pa ni gnad 'di dag

rje sa chen gyi dbang bzhi ngo sprod kyi 'grel pa/ rje btsun rtse mo'i mngon rtogs rgyas pa/ rje btsun rin po che'i mngon rtogs ljon shing / 'khor 'das dbyer med kyi 'grel pa/ rga ston spring yig rnams las gsal bar 'byung la/ gzhan yang / rgyud gsum gyi 'grel pa sogs gong ma'i gsung rab rnams las cha shas kyis 'byung ba ni skal ba dang ldan pa rnams yid ches pa'i lung khungs yin no/ /de dag la yid mi ches pa rnams kyis kyang / sngar drangs pa'i rgyud gzhung rnam par dag pa'i lung rnams la brten nas ma 'khyogs pa'i blo gros kyis dpyad cing rang gzhan la phan par bya'o/ /gnyis pa de nyid lam byed bzhis lam du byed pa'i tshul ni sngar bshad pa'i sbyang gzhi dang sbyong byed de dag thams cad kyang / 'dra chos dang / mtshon don rtogs pa rang dga' bas bsgrigs pa tsam ma yin gyi/ sems kun gzhi'i steng du mya ngan las 'das pa'i chos thams cad kyi bag chags gnas pa'i stobs kyis/ kun rdzob kyi snang ba thams cad 'bras bu sangs rgyas kyi sa'i gzugs sku dang / chos sku'i rnam pa rang bzhin rnam dag gi tshul gyis 'byung ba yin par ni rtsa rgyud phyi ma'i bcu gcig par/ lus can thams cad kha dog dang dbyibs kyi sgo nas rigs lngar nges tshul gsungs pas shes la/ de'i phyir bsgoms pas glo bur gyi dri ma dag ste/ mngon du 'gyur ba ni sbyang gzhi dang / sbyong byed mtshon don bsgrigs pa'i don no/ /des na 'di la sbyang gzhi thams cad lam gyis rnam pa de dang der bsgom pa'i tshul dang / de nyid lam byed bzhis byin gyis brlab pa'i tshul gnyis las/ dang po ni rgyas par sngar bshad zin cing / mtshan gzhi gcig la sbyar na mngal skyes kyi ma'i phyag rgya gru gsum dang / sgong skyes kyi sgo nga sogs bzhi po ma dag pa'i phyag rgya sogs ma yin gyi/ bdag gi blo la snang ba'i chos 'byung gru gsum 'di nyid yin no snyam du dbyer med du bsgom pa'o/

/gnyis pa ni de ltar chos 'byung gru gsum du bsgoms pas rnam pa gzugs kyi rnam pa bsgom sla bas rnam pa lam du byed pa zhes bya/ de nyid rnam thar sgo gsum dang / spyan la sogs pa'i phyag rgyar mos pa byas pas/ mos pa lam du byed pa zhes bya/ de yang sangs rgyas sa'i 'bras bu rnam thar sgo gsum dang / spyan la sogs pa'i phyag rgya dngos yin par bsgoms pas 'bras bu lam du byed pa zhes bya/ des rnal 'byor pa'i sems rgyud byin gyis brlabs shing tshogs rdzogs pas byin rlabs lam du byed pa zhes bya ste/ de'i rgyu mtshan yang zhen pas 'jug cing 'brel pas mi bslu ba'i lam yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de la zhen pas 'jug pa ni/ sbyang gzhi la rnam par zhen/ rnam pa la 'bras bu dngos su zhen pa'o/ /'brel pas mi bslu ba ni sbyang gzhi dang / lam dang / 'bras bu sum char yang gcig la gcig 'brel pa'am/ don la dbyer med pas mi bslu ba ste/ bskyed pa'i rim pa'i sbyang gzhi dang / sbyong byed bsgoms pas sangs rgyas kyi sa'i chos thams cad 'thob pa'i rgyu mtshan yang 'di nyid yin no/ /de ltar rnal 'byor bcu po sbyang gzhi sbyong byed sbyar zhing / lam byed bzhi ldan du brtson pa drag pos bsgoms pas drod chung ngu thob pa na/ kun 'dar gsang nas spyod/ des drod 'bring thob pa na/ kun 'dar 'jig rten pa'i mngon du spyod/ des lung bstan pa'i bu mo padma can la brten nas drod chen po thob pa na/ kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa zla ba gcig gis sa brgyad pa thob ste/ nye rgyu spyod pa'i skal ba dang ldan par 'gyur zhing / de nas nye rgyu zhag bdun gyis rdo rje 'chang chen po'i sa bcu gsum pa thob par 'gyur pa ni nges pa'o// ༈ //kun mkhyen bla ma'i legs bshad zla zer gyis/ /lam bzang snang ba gsal bar mdzad pa las/ /man ngag ku mu ta ka bye ba'i chu/ /don gnyer blo yi re ba skong phyir sbyin/

/rab dkar dge tshogs gang zhig grub pa des/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis bsngags pa'i zhing gi mchog /bde ba can zhes grags par skyes gyur nas/ /'od dpag med pa'i zhal mchog mthong bar shog /don dam spros bral mngon du ma gyur kyang / /sna tshogs rgyud sde'i dgongs pa dri med la/ /rnam bkra'i blo gros gang gi drin nyid las/ /legs par thob pa'i rje btsun zhabs pad la/ /sgo gsum dwang bas rtag tu phyag 'tshal zhing / /lus dang longs spyod dus gsum dge rtsa yis/ /rgyun du mchod do thugs rje'i lcags kyu yis/ /da dung srid mtha'i bar du rjes gzung gsol/ /rje btsun bla ma'i legs bshad gnad kyi zla zer 'phags yul gyi kye rdo rje'i lam yongs su rdzogs pa'i lam srol drug rdzogs par bshad pa'i nang nas blo dman pa rnams la phan pa'i phyir man ngag lugs logs su bkol te/ gsung sgros khyad par can 'ga' zhig dang / rje btsun gong ma'i gsung rab kyi nang nas bsnan kha 'ga' zhig dang bcas te 'bri dgos so zhes don gnyer du mas bskul te/ mgo brtsams nas yun ring du ma grub pa la/ dus phyis bstan pa dri ma med pa'i khur gyis lci ba mkhan chen sangs rgyas rgya mtsho ba'i gsung gis bskul bas rkyen byas nas/ rje bla mas legs bshad gnad kyi zla zer sgyur byed ces bya ba/ sa mo phag gi lo la brtsam nas lo drug cu re drug 'das pa/ sna tshogs 'byig ces pa shing mo sbrul gyi lo la/ shākya'i dge slong bsod nams seng ges thub bstan rnam par rgyal ba'i dgon par legs par grub pa'i yi ge pa ni gzhon nu bzang po'o// //dge'o// // ༄༅/ /na maḥsaṅgu ru pā dā ya/ kun khyab dmigs pa med pa'i snyeng rje'i rtsal/ /ma 'gag rang bzhin rnam pa thams cad kyi/ /mchog las mi 'gyur 'od gsal shes rab che/ /zung 'jug srid zhi kun khyab dges mdzad mgon/ /des gsung rgyud kyi yang snying rnal 'byor bcu/

/'doms mdzad dpal ldan chos skyong sras bcas kyi/ /lugs mchog sgros ngan spangs pa 'di tsam zhes/ /mdo rgyud gdams pa'i nga ros 'bod rgyangs mkhan/ /de rgyun bsod nams gser gyi sgong sbubs las/ /skyes pa sde bzhi'i gdong mdzes dge chos kyi/ /'khor los lag brel sa bstan pa tshe ring spyod 'jig rten mes/ /grags pa'i gsung snyan yan lag rdzogs pa can/ /gang des spel pa'i rnam dkar dge ba'i mthus/ /chos 'dul mngon pa mdo dang rgyud sde'i gnad/ /mtha' drug lam nas 'dren la mi 'jigs gdeng / /'jam dpal gzhon nus byin gyur sa skya pa/ /brgyud par bcas pa'i ring lugs dar gyur cig /tshul 'dir rgyu sbyor dkar po'i bag chags rgyun/ /bzhag pas bsdus pa'i lus can byang chub bar/ /yang srid bla ma lhag pa'i lhas byin brlabs/ /mkhas pa'i bgyi bas bstan pa rgyas byed shog /de skad dmar ser zhes bya'i lor/ /sa spyod thugs bskyed lde mig gi /'phrul gyis chos sbyin ma mo'i sgo/ /'bum phrag gsar du phye ba'i skabs/ /rje btsun bla ma rnams kyi thugs/ /brtse bas legs bskyangs chos 'di'i rigs/ /skyes pas skal ba sbom gyur ming / /tshul khrims rin chen btags pas bris// //maṅgalaṃ// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 168 kun mkhyen go bo rab 'byams pa/ kye rdo rje man ngag lugs kyi bskyed rim/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 167
